provenance.limitations: Serine is a direct enzyme substrate. Endogenous synthesis and diet can both supply it; this does not show that dietary serine or protein intake increases cystathionine formation.

Cysteine is the substrate of the first assembly step. A formula that removed methionine and cysteine together slowed whole-blood synthesis, and that formula also removed methionine. When methionine intake stayed adequate, removing cysteine did not lower red-cell synthesis in young men. Supported upstream supply through glutathione-dependent epithelial redox protection, not an established dietary constraint on endotoxin spillover. Human precursor tracing measured red-cell glutathione after combined glycine and N-acetylcysteine; epithelial experiments measured oxidant-induced paracellular permeability. In Salmonella-infected rats, glutathione depletion did not increase permeability or bacterial translocation. Neither intestinal precursor inadequacy, individual constituent limitation, human LPS reduction nor benefit from additional intake is established.

provenance.limitations: Human target engagement varies by formulation, tissue and population. The positive study used a myrosinase-completed broccoli sprout homogenate for three days in healthy nonsmokers and measured nasal phase II enzyme RNA, not Nrf2 protein or nuclear translocation. Extract capsules did not increase lung target-gene expression in COPD. An ordinary broccoli meal, direct activation of Nrf2 in the human brain and clinical ADHD benefit remain unestablished. Sulforaphane is not an essential nutrient.

In selenium-deficient adults, plasma glutathione peroxidase activity levelled off once intake reached about 35 micrograms a day. Intake above that plateau did not raise the enzyme further, and the study did not measure net oxidative pressure.

provenance.input: Nicotinic acid (a form of vitamin B3)
provenance.limitations: In five adults with mitochondrial myopathy, niacin at 750–1,000 mg/day raised blood NAD⁺ and brought muscle NAD⁺ to the control level. That is medical dosing in a deficiency disease, not a result for adequate everyday intake, and attention was not measured.
Most cells outside the liver do not run the full route. The review does not establish what share of the NAD⁺ pool comes from tryptophan, and eating more protein is not shown to raise NAD⁺.

provenance.limitations: Preparation-, dose- and population-specific. The positive study used 30 g/day for four weeks in ten healthy participants; this is not an effective whole-food dose. Preserve the later 40 g/day type-2-diabetes null. SCFA mediation and universal benefit are unestablished; no brain or ADHD inference.

Admission concerns a circulating hormone response in studied supplement/enriched-oil contexts. It does not establish adipose secretion, receptor sensitivity, universal benefit, ordinary-food efficacy or a food-effective dose. Mixture and carrier effects are not attributed to DHA alone; DHA-specific attribution uses the separate DHA-versus-EPA trial.
